name: Soukai no Valkyria ~Kokou no Oujo Lutia~
original_name: 蒼海のヴァルキュリア ～孤高の皇女ルツィア～
source:
A long lasting war.... There is a submarine that only female soldiers are on board. However, the ship is captured by an enemy country and the war finally ends.... The soldiers are still kept hostage, but they believe in the return to their homeland....

[From ErogeShop]
